title: Reframing Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning: From Absolute to Relative Representations
title_zh: 重新审视以对象为中心的强化学习：从绝对表示到相对表示

paragraphs.en: Object-centric reinforcement learning agents typically receive each object’s position in a fixed global frame, even though their decisions usually depend on where objects are relative to one another. These absolute views often fail to capture the local context that is most relevant to the agent’s behavior. As a result, an agent must relearn the same response at every location where a configuration can occur, and its performance collapses when the scene is merely shifted. In this work, we propose a shift toward Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA), where entities are described in a relative frame of reference. To operationalize this idea, we introduce Object-Relative inductive-Bias Transformers (ORBiT), a transformer-based architecture for processing anchor-relative inputs in reinforcement learning. Our results suggest these relative representations improve performance for both MLP and transformer agents. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ORBiT outperforms the pixel-based PPO baseline, achieving an aggregate HNS IQM greater than 1.0 over 13 Atari games. ORBiT learns the game of Foosball from scratch, dominating all baselines. In our controlled Tag environment, we further show that ORCA extends to rotations, that ORBiT generalizes to unseen numbers of distractors, and that these gains require a decision-relevant anchor.

paragraphs.en: Ask a person where their keys are, and they will not answer in coordinates; they will say next to the bowl , on the left side of the desk , or behind you . Human spatial reasoning often uses spatial anchors and relative frames of reference ( Levinson, 2003 ) . Scenes are parsed into bounded objects with persistent identity, and the position of each object is encoded in a frame tied to the body or to nearby landmarks rather than in a single fixed global system ( Klatzky, 1998 ; Spelke, 1990 ; Scholl, 2001 ; Burgess, 2006 ) . Object-centric reinforcement learning (OCRL) has internalized the first of these two ideas: rather than feeding pixels to a policy, OCRL extracts a set of objects with type, position, and velocity, and lets the agent reason over the resulting structured representation ( Diuk et al., 2008 ; Baker et al., 2020 ; Delfosse et al., 2024a ; Delfosse et al., 2024b ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . The second idea, using anchors and relative frames of reference, has been independently adopted in multi-agent reinforcement learning, robotics, biology, and linguistics, where observations relative to the agent’s position are more commonly used ( Gupta et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Shang et al., 2021 ; Levinson, 2003 ) , yet it remains largely absent from OCRL. The absolute-coordinate convention appears to have been inherited from early object-vector pipelines and rarely revisited.
paragraphs.zh: 问一个人他们的钥匙在哪里，他们不会用坐标回答，而是会说“在碗旁边”、“在桌子左边”或“在你身后”。 人类的空间推理通常使用空间锚点和相对参照系（Levinson, 2003）。 场景被解析为具有持久身份的有界对象，每个对象的位置在绑定于身体或附近地标的参照系中编码，而不是在单一固定的全局系统中编码（Klatzky, 1998; Spelke, 1990; Scholl, 2001; Burgess, 2006）。 以对象为中心的强化学习（OCRL）已经内化了这两个想法中的第一个：OCRL 不是将像素输入策略，而是提取一组具有类型、位置和速度的对象，并让智能体对由此产生的结构化表示进行推理（Diuk et al., 2008; Baker et al., 2020; Delfosse et al., 2024a; Delfosse et al., 2024b; Ye et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2026）。 第二个想法，即使用锚点和相对参照系，已在多智能体强化学习、机器人学、生物学和语言学中被独立采用，在这些领域中，相对于智能体位置的观测更为常用（Gupta et al., 2017; Wang et al., 2020; Shang et al., 2021; Levinson, 2003），但它在 OCRL 中基本上仍然缺席。 绝对坐标的惯例似乎是从早期的对象向量流水线继承而来的，并且很少被重新审视。

paragraphs.en: From classical object-vector pipelines using multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to recent transformer-based variants, OCRL serves object features to the policy in the absolute frame of reference or global coordinates ( Anand et al., 2019 ; Zadaianchuk et al., 2021 ; Mambelli et al., 2022 ; Haramati et al., 2024 ; Delfosse et al., 2024a ) . This leaves inter-object relations implicit: For example, a cauldron 5 pixels to the right of the player in Asterix maps to a different input at every screen location, so the agent must relearn the same response from scratch at each position (see Figure 1 ). The result is fragility under spatial perturbations, frame translation, and platform shifts, even when the relative scene is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 从使用多层感知机（MLP）的经典对象向量流水线到近期基于变换器的变体，OCRL 都以绝对参考系或全局坐标的形式向策略提供对象特征（Anand et al., 2019；Zadaianchuk et al., 2021；Mambelli et al., 2022；Haramati et al., 2024；Delfosse et al., 2024a）。 这使得对象间的关系保持隐式：例如，在《Asterix》中位于玩家右侧 5 个像素处的大锅，在屏幕上的每个位置都会映射为不同的输入，因此智能体必须在每个位置从头重新学习相同的响应（见图 1）。 其结果是，即使在相对场景未发生改变的情况下，面对空间扰动、帧平移和平台迁移时依然十分脆弱。

paragraphs.en: We close this gap with ORBiT (Object-Relative inductive-Bias Transformer): an Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA) input that encodes each object’s position and velocity in the relative frame of a designated anchor object (typically the player or important entities like the ball in Foosball ), fed into a transformer encoder that is order-invariant and count-flexible by construction. When trained on the Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ; Machado et al., 2018b ) and tested across the HackAtari benchmark ( Delfosse et al., 2025 ) , switching the inputs from absolute coordinates to ORCA raises the interquartile mean (IQM) performance from 0.54 0.54 to 1.10 1.10 in the human-normalized score (HNS, see Appendix A ), moving it from below a pixel baseline without access to objects ( 0.69 0.69 ) to approximately human level. Testing robustness, we see that ORBiT loses only 4 % 4\% of its score on the HackAtari test suite, whereas absolute coordinates yield a 30 % 30\% drop. In Foosball — a challenging 8-DoF (degrees of freedom) robotics environment that requires robust policies in the presence of changing opponent behavior ( Moos et al., 2024 ) — ORBiT concedes only 73 goals out of 50,000 against its absolute-coordinate baseline OCT. In Tag , an environment where the player has to catch a target without being distracted by other moving objects, ORBiT reaches 22.4 catches within 500 steps, whereas OCT is barely able to catch the target (1.8).

paragraphs.en: We formalize Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA) representations, in which object positions and velocities are expressed relative to a task-relevant object.
paragraphs.zh: 我们形式化了固定于锚点（Anchor）的物体相对坐标（ORCA）表示，其中物体的位置和速度相对于与任务相关的物体来表示。

paragraphs.en: We present ORBiT , a transformer encoder over ORCA-encoded object sets that is order-invariant and count-flexible by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ORBiT，一个作用于 ORCA 编码对象集合的 Transformer 编码器，其结构天然具有顺序不变性和数量灵活性。

paragraphs.en: We show that ORBiT improves end performance and robustness to spatial perturbations (translation and platform shifts) compared to absolute-coordinate variants, which substantially degrade under the same perturbations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，与绝对坐标变体相比，ORBiT 提升了最终性能以及对空间扰动（平移和平台偏移）的鲁棒性，而绝对坐标变体在相同扰动下会显著退化。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Tag , a controlled environment with oriented, moving objects in which object count, the anchor, and landmarks can be varied independently. This lets us evaluate ORCA with an oriented anchor, where it applies the full rigid-body transform.

paragraphs.en: In the remainder of the paper, we formalize ORCA representations, describe the ORBiT architecture, and evaluate its effectiveness across multiple environments and generalization settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在论文的其余部分，我们将形式化 ORCA 表示，描述 ORBiT 架构，并在多种环境和泛化设置下评估其有效性。

paragraphs.en: We model the environment with object-centric representations, where the agent receives at each step t t a set of N t N_{t} objects 𝒪 t = { o t 1 , … , o t N t } \mathcal{O}_{t}=\{o^{1}_{t},\dots,o^{N_{t}}_{t}\} from an upstream detector, such as SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) , OCAtari ( Delfosse et al., 2024a ) , or similar. Each object o t i o^{i}_{t} is a feature vector of intrinsic 𝐜 t i \mathbf{c}^{i}_{t} and extrinsic 𝐞 t i \mathbf{e}^{i}_{t} attributes. Intrinsic attributes may cover the object type, color, and size, while the extrinsic attributes feature the absolute position 𝐩 t i \mathbf{p}^{i}_{t} , velocity 𝐯 t i \mathbf{v}^{i}_{t} , acceleration 𝐚 t i \mathbf{a}^{i}_{t} , and the heading angle φ t i \varphi^{i}_{t} of the object in the absolute environment frame. paragraphs.en: Representing the scene as a graph over all objects is a genuine alternative, with a long history in relational RL, object-oriented MDPs, and graph networks ( Battaglia et al., 2018 ) ; see Section 5 . Given displacement edge features p t i − p t j p^{i}_{t}-p^{j}_{t} , such a model obtains the same translation invariance that ORCA does, so the choice between the two is not about whether the invariance is available, but about what it costs to obtain. A graph-based policy constructs edge features that scale quadratically with N t N_{t} , evaluates a learned edge function on each, and introduces design decisions, such as edge parameterization or aggregation schemes, that must be specified and tuned before the invariance can be of any use. paragraphs.en: Forgoing a full graph evaluation requires selecting a single anchor object. This choice mirrors real-world human spatial cognition, which is fundamentally biased toward an egocentric frame of reference ( Wang & Spelke, 2002 ) . When playing video games, humans naturally adopt a player-centric perspective, which motivated our design of the coordinate system. We therefore use the player object as the anchor wherever the game provides one. More generally, we select as anchor the object whose relations to the rest of the scene are most decision-relevant, i.e., the object that the agent’s actions most directly act upon or through.
paragraphs.zh: 放弃完整的图评估需要选定一个单一锚点对象。 这一选择呼应了现实世界中人类空间认知从根本上偏向以自我为中心的参照系这一特点（Wang & Spelke, 2002）。 在玩电子游戏时，人类会自然采用以玩家为中心的视角，这启发了我们对坐标系的设计。 因此，只要游戏提供了玩家对象，我们就将其用作锚点。 更一般地，我们选择其与场景中其余部分的关系对决策最相关的对象作为锚点，即智能体的动作最直接作用于其上或通过其进行的对象。

paragraphs.en: To process object-centric observations flexibly and expressively, we build on the transformer architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , which has proven effective at modeling interactions among sets of entities. The transformer’s raw self-attention mechanism enables reasoning over unordered inputs ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , making it a natural fit for RL agents operating on object-based sets extracted from structured environments. paragraphs.en: While the absolute coordinate transformer OCT falls behind the pixel-input PPO CNN {}^{\text{\tiny CNN}} (IQM: 0.69 0.69 , 95% CI: [ 0.66 0.66 , 0.72 0.72 ]), despite receiving clean object states rather than raw pixels, ORBiT gains enough performance through ORCA to clear this baseline. This means that without a reference anchor, the transformer fails to capture position-dependent correlations that do not hold across the game’s spatial extent. The confidence interval for ORBiT (OCT+ORCA) spans 1.04 1.04 – 1.16 1.16 IQM and still shows a substantial improvement over pure OCT. The same holds in the Tag environment, where ORBiT reaches 22.4 catches, compared with 1.8 for OCT (see Figure 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然绝对坐标变换器 OCT 落后于像素输入的 PPO CNN {}^{\text{\tiny CNN}}（IQM：0.69 0.69，95% 置信区间：[ 0.66 0.66, 0.72 0.72 ]），尽管它接收的是干净的目标状态而非原始像素，但 ORBiT 通过 ORCA 获得了足够高的性能，超过了这一基线。 这意味着在没有参考锚点的情况下，变换器无法捕获那些在整个游戏空间范围内并不成立的、依赖于位置的关联。 ORBiT（OCT+ORCA）的置信区间横跨 1.04 1.04 – 1.16 1.16 IQM，并且相较于纯 OCT 仍然显示出显著的提升。 在 Tag 环境中情况同样如此，ORBiT 达到了 22.4 次捕获，而 OCT 仅为 1.8 次（见图 7）。

paragraphs.en: To separate these contributions, we isolate two effects: first, the improvement using ORCA; second, we measure the difference between OCT and PPObj, isolating the architecture effect (both use global inputs). Here, the transformer alone does not help.

paragraphs.en: Besides the benefits of using ORCA within the transformer agent, we can also observe an improvement in performance of Δ + 0.15 \Delta{+}0.15 (from 0.62 0.62 to 0.77 0.77 ) with 95% CI [ 0.09 0.09 , 0.22 0.22 ] within the MLP agent PPObj to bring it in line with the PPO CNN {}^{\text{\tiny CNN}} baseline (IQM: 0.69 0.69 , 95% CI: [ 0.66 0.66 , 0.72 0.72 ]).
paragraphs.zh: 除了在 transformer 智能体中使用 ORCA 带来的收益之外，我们还可以观察到 MLP 智能体 PPObj 的性能提升 Δ + 0.15 \Delta{+}0.15（从 0.62 0.62 提升到 0.77 0.77），95% CI 为 [ 0.09 0.09 , 0.22 0.22 ]，使其与 PPO CNN {}^{\text{\tiny CNN}} 基线（IQM: 0.69 0.69 ，95% CI: [ 0.66 0.66 , 0.72 0.72 ]）处于同一水平。

paragraphs.en: However, neither improvement alone clears the human baseline; PPObj-ORCA sits at 0.77 0.77 (95% CI [ 0.71 0.71 , 0.84 0.84 ]) and OCT at 0.54 0.54 (95% CI [ 0.51 0.51 , 0.58 0.58 ]), but the combination does, reaching 1.10 1.10 (see Figure 4 ) with a 95% CI [ 1.04 1.04 , 1.16 1.16 ].

The most plausible explanation is that the transformer can attend to each object’s anchor-relative features independently and compose them, whereas an MLP concatenates all objects into a fixed-size vector and must re-learn any relational structure the ORCA encoding makes explicit. Overall, we can say that ORCA improved performance in both cases. The substantial gap between Δ + 0.56 \Delta{+}0.56 and Δ + 0.15 \Delta{+}0.15 is primarily driven by a few games, e.g., Asterix (see Table 8 ), suggesting that the transformer may disproportionately amplify ORCA in specific games while maintaining a similar impact across most others.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Theorem 1 ( Appendix B ), ORCA is guaranteed to be invariant to transformations in the coordinate frame. Hence, these results on Translate serve as an empirical check of the follow-up Corollary 1 . OCT loses Δ = − 50 % \Delta=-50\% under global and is essentially unaffected ( ≈ 1 % \approx 1\% ) under player-centric (ORBiT). PPObj drops 44% under global inputs and is also essentially unaffected ( 5 % 5\% ) with ORCA. Since ORCA inputs are identical by construction, deviations from 100% reflect evaluation stochasticity. PPO CNN {}^{\text{\tiny CNN}} collapses by 88%, with no anchor-relative variant to compare. Looking at shuffle , OCT is unaffected regardless of representation ( Δ ≈ 0 \Delta\approx 0 ) — permutation-invariance holds at test time and does not depend on ORCA being active. PPObj drops 85–93% regardless of representation; its MLP has no analogous bias, and ORCA does not compensate.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, ORBiT enables the first autonomous agent trained from scratch via self-play to play the full game of Foosball . paragraphs.en: An agent receiving world-frame positions must learn that the same relative configuration, i.e., a cauldron 5 pixels to the right of the player in Asterix , is equivalent everywhere it can occur, and thus the agent must learn it again at every location. This is evident in the results of the translated -frame experiment. ORCA states the equivalence directly: two scenes differing by a global translation produce identical inputs. The robustness results follow from the same property, since perturbations that shift absolute coordinates without changing relative structure are invisible to an ORCA policy and catastrophic for one trained on world-frame inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 接收世界坐标系位置的智能体必须学到，同样的相对构型，即《Asterix》中玩家右侧 5 像素处的大锅，在其可能出现的任何位置都是等价的，因此该智能体必须在每个位置重新学习它。 这在平移坐标系实验的结果中得到了明显体现。 ORCA 直接表述了这种等价性：仅相差一个全局平移的两个场景产生相同的输入。 鲁棒性结果也源于同一性质，因为那些移动绝对坐标但不改变相对结构的扰动对 ORCA 策略是不可见的，而对基于世界坐标系输入训练的策略则是灾难性的。

paragraphs.en: We do not claim this inductive bias is novel: anchoring observations to the acting agent has proven effective in multi-agent RL ( Shang et al., 2021 ) . Object-centric RL, however, has largely retained absolute coordinates, feeding object features to the policy in a fixed global frame. Our results show that revisiting this input convention yields substantial gains in both performance and robustness.

paragraphs.en: ORCA is a drop-in observation wrapper, with no change to the policy architecture, the training algorithm, or the reward. As such, any pipeline that consumes absolute-coordinate object vectors can adopt it by substituting a single transformation at the input. Furthermore, our Foosball results show that ORBiT handles fast, continuous control in simulation. Although a game, Foosball shares key demands with real-world robotics, including fast system dynamics and 8-DoF continuous action execution. This makes ORBiT a promising candidate for robotic and other continuous-control domains, pending validation on physical hardware with imperfect object detection.

paragraphs.en: First, our current implementation is constrained to 2D environments; extending this approach to 3D continuous spaces will be necessary for broader real-world robotic deployment. Second, our state formulation evaluates coordinates relative to a single target entity. This anchor is currently selected manually per environment based on domain knowledge; learning to identify the most decision-relevant anchor automatically would remove this design choice and make the approach more readily transferable to new tasks. Our evaluation in Tag highlights this matter; with an anchor that is not decision-relevant, most of the gain disappears. Looping back to relational RL, i.e., modeling inter-object spatial relationships across all entities in the scene, is a promising direction for enhancing relational reasoning in the context of relative coordinate frames. Further, we assume a perfect object extractor in our work. The influence of detection quality should be studied in general for OCRL. Finally, in most of our experiments, we restricted our inputs to positional coordinates and velocities only. Studying richer feature spaces, such as object bounding dimensions, dynamic properties, or semantic labels, could unlock further improvements in OCRL.

paragraphs.en: Unlike traditional pixel-based inputs or global feature vectors, object-centric views abstract the environment into discrete entities, enabling relational reasoning and compositional learning. Foundational methods such as Slot Attention ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) have enabled unsupervised object discovery, while platforms like OCAtari ( Delfosse et al., 2024a ) provide structured object-level access to classic benchmarks. Empirical studies report the benefits of such representations for policy learning ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) and transferability ( Yoon et al., 2023 ; Didolkar et al., 2025 ) . More recently, Ugadiarov et al. (2025) combine actor-critic learning with an object-centric world model to exploit relational structure in RL. In contrast, ORBiT is model-free and focuses on the representational choice itself: objects are encoded relative to a task-relevant anchor rather than in absolute coordinates. While most approaches encode objects in a global coordinate frame, they frequently overlook the perspective-dependent structure that often guides agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统的基于像素的输入或全局特征向量不同，以对象为中心的视角将环境抽象为离散实体，从而支持关系推理与组合学习。 Slot Attention（Locatello et al., 2020）等基础方法实现了无监督的对象发现，而 OCAtari（Delfosse et al., 2024a）等平台则为经典基准提供了结构化的对象级访问接口。 实证研究报道了此类表示对策略学习（Ye et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2026）和可迁移性（Yoon et al., 2023; Didolkar et al., 2025）的益处。 最近，Ugadiarov 等人 （2025）将 actor-critic 学习与以对象为中心的世界模型相结合，以利用强化学习中的关系结构。 相比之下，ORBiT 是无模型的，并聚焦于表示选择本身：对象相对于与任务相关的锚点进行编码，而非使用绝对坐标。 大多数方法在全局坐标系中对对象进行编码，却常常忽略了通常引导智能体行为的依赖视角的结构。

paragraphs.en: Similar to ORBiT, Relational Reinforcement Learning ( Džeroski et al., 2001 ; Van Otterlo & Kersting, 2004 ; Kersting et al., 2004 ) and Object-Oriented MDPs (OO-MDPs) ( Diuk et al., 2008 ) , address the following problem: how to exploit objects and their relations so an RL agent can generalize across environments and different numbers of objects. The main difference from ORBiT is their focus: classical Relational RL, on the one hand, typically uses first-order logic or relational rules to describe relations. OO-MDP, on the other hand, centers around the object interactions within the transition model. In contrast, ORBiT instead utilizes an egocentric view, encoding objects relative to a specified anchor object.

paragraphs.en: Transformers have become increasingly popular in RL due to their capacity to model relational structure via self-attention. For example, the Set Transformer ( Lee et al., 2019 ) introduced an attention-based architecture for permutation-invariant processing of unordered sets. Early applications, such as the Decision Transformer ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , framed RL as a sequence-modeling problem, while others ( Parisotto et al., 2020 ; Hu et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2022 ; Esslinger et al., 2022 ) adapted transformers for partially observable or multi-agent settings. In object-centric settings, transformers have been used to model interactions between entities ( Zadaianchuk et al., 2021 ; Mambelli et al., 2022 ) , though these models often rely on goal conditioning or absolute positions, thereby limiting their ability to generalize across spatial variations. Additionally, they typically employ aggregation mechanisms that are sensitive to input size or ordering, reducing flexibility in dynamic environments. More recently, Haramati et al. (2024) introduced an entity interaction transformer for OCRL that combines object-centric representations with attention-based state, goal, and entity-interaction modeling, enabling multi-object manipulation from pixels and generalizing to more objects than were seen during training. ORBiT complements these works. It uses a transformer to reason over sets of objects in relative frames of reference and therefore leans on anchor-relative object representations as an inductive bias to guide and elevate learning.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 因其能够通过自注意力机制对关系结构进行建模，在强化学习中变得越来越流行。 例如，Set Transformer（Lee et al., 2019）提出了一种基于注意力的架构，用于对无序集合进行置换不变的处理。 早期的应用，如 Decision Transformer（Chen et al., 2021），将强化学习构建为一个序列建模问题；而其他工作（Parisotto et al., 2020；Hu et al., 2021；Yang et al., 2022；Esslinger et al., 2022）则将 Transformer 改造用于部分可观测或多智能体场景。 在以对象为中心的场景中，Transformer 已被用于建模实体之间的交互（Zadaianchuk et al., 2021；Mambelli et al., 2022），但这些模型通常依赖目标条件化或绝对位置，从而限制了它们在空间变化上的泛化能力。 此外，它们通常采用对输入规模或顺序敏感的聚合机制，降低了在动态环境中的灵活性。 最近，Haramati 等人 （2024）提出了一种用于以对象为中心强化学习（OCRL）的实体交互 Transformer，它将以对象为中心的表示与基于注意力的状态、目标和实体交互建模相结合，能够从像素实现多对象操控，并泛化到比训练时更多的对象。 ORBiT 是对这些工作的补充。 它使用 Transformer 在相对参考系中对对象集合进行推理，因而借助锚点相对的对象表示作为归纳偏置，以引导并提升学习效果。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work explores how inductive biases can enhance generalization in spatially structured tasks. Works on relational architectures, including Graph Networks ( Battaglia et al., 2018 ) , argue that representing entities, relations, and compositional structure provides a useful bias for systematic generalization. Building on this perspective, transformer-based architectures with explicit relational structure ( Altabaa et al., 2024 ; Altabaa & Lafferty, 2025 ) and object-centric attention mechanisms ( Blüml et al., 2026 ) have shown promising results in learning efficiency and transfer. These methods highlight the importance of modeling relations between entities, but they typically assume absolute positions in global coordinate frames. Drawing inspiration from cognitive science and neuroscience, recent work has suggested that egocentric inductive biases can improve robustness and behavioral relevance in reinforcement learning systems (see next paragraph). Our work follows this motivation, but instead of relying on explicit graph structure, we use self-attention over object tokens and introduce anchor-relative spatial coordinates as an inductive bias for object-centric RL.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究工作探讨了归纳偏置如何能在具有空间结构的任务中增强泛化能力。 关于关系型架构的研究（包括图网络（Battaglia 等，2018））认为，对实体、关系和组合结构进行表示，能为系统性泛化提供一种有用的偏置。 基于这一视角，具有显式关系结构的基于 transformer 的架构（Altabaa 等，2024；Altabaa & Lafferty，2025）以及以对象为中心的注意力机制（Blüml 等，2026），在学习效率和迁移方面已展现出可喜的成果。 这些方法凸显了建模实体之间关系的重要性，但它们通常假设实体处于全局坐标系中的绝对位置。 受认知科学和神经科学的启发，最近的研究表明，以自我为中心的归纳偏置可以提高强化学习系统的鲁棒性和行为相关性（见下一段）。 我们的工作遵循这一动机，但不依赖显式的图结构，而是对对象 token 使用自注意力，并引入相对于锚点的空间坐标作为以对象为中心的强化学习的归纳偏置。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between egocentric (agent-relative) and allocentric (world-relative) representations has been extensively studied in cognitive science and neuroscience, with evidence that biological agents frequently operate in egocentric frames to support robust spatial reasoning ( Klatzky, 1998 ; Galati et al., 2000 ; Burgess, 2006 ) . Similar principles have informed navigation and control in robotics, where encoding observations relative to an agent or task-relevant anchor improves sample efficiency and generalization ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Despite these precedents, most RL approaches continue to rely on absolute spatial encodings. ORBiT also operates on sets of object observations, but our focus is on RL with anchor-relative object representations. Agent-centric methods have been explored in multi-agent RL, where representing observations relative to the acting agent improves sample efficiency and generalization ( Shang et al., 2021 ) . Our work brings this idea to single-agent object-centric RL by encoding each object relative to a task-relevant anchor and combining this with a transformer-based policy.

sents.en: Agent-centric methods have been explored in multi-agent RL, where representing observations relative to the acting agent improves sample efficiency and generalization ( Shang et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 以智能体为中心的方法已在多智能体强化学习中被探索，其中相对于执行动作的智能体来表征观测可以提升样本效率和泛化能力（Shang et al., 2021）。

sents.en: Our work brings this idea to single-agent object-centric RL by encoding each object relative to a task-relevant anchor and combining this with a transformer-based policy.
sents.zh: 我们的工作将这一思想引入单智能体以对象为中心的强化学习，通过将每个对象相对于任务相关锚点进行编码，并将其与基于 Transformer 的策略相结合。

paragraphs.en: Aside from the methodological part of this work, we test our approach on the game of Foosball . Moos et al. (2024) identify Foosball as a challenging robotic environment and an important stepping stone towards more complex robotics applications. In recent years, a couple of works have automated a Foosball table and created a digital twin ( So et al., 2025 ; Croenen et al., 2024 ; Rohrer et al., 2021 ; De Blasi et al., 2021 ) , highlighting the interest in, and challenges of this task. While the idea of an automated Foosball table is not new ( Weigel & Nebel, 2002 ) , the majority of Foosball agents are still rule-based and hand-coded ( Založnik & Šoln, 2024 ) . As training the full game with 4 rods from scratch is demanding, much of the work focuses on learning individual skills such as scoring, passing, and blocking ( Moos et al., 2024 ; Croenen et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, in this work, we use ORBiT to learn to play Foosball from scratch via self-play using the PPO algorithm. For this, we base our implementation on the work of Moos et al. (2024) and introduce mixed self-play, a form of domain randomization ( Tobin et al., 2017 ) , to boost early-stage training by enabling training across highly varied strategic scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 除了本文的方法论部分之外，我们在桌上足球（Foosball）游戏上测试了我们的方法。Moos 等人 （2024）将桌上足球确定为一个具有挑战性的机器人环境，也是迈向更复杂机器人应用的重要基石。 近年来，已有若干工作对桌上足球球台进行了自动化并创建了数字孪生（So 等人，2025；Croenen 等人，2024；Rohrer 等人，2021；De Blasi 等人，2021），凸显了人们对这一任务的兴趣及其挑战性。 虽然自动化桌上足球球台的想法并不新鲜（Weigel 与 Nebel，2002），但大多数桌上足球智能体仍然基于规则并由手工编码（Založnik 与 Šoln，2024）。 由于从头训练包含 4 根操纵杆的完整游戏要求很高，许多工作都聚焦于学习单个技能，例如射门、传球和防守（Moos 等人，2024；Croenen 等人，2024）。 与之相反，在本工作中，我们使用 ORBiT，通过采用 PPO 算法的自我博弈来从头学习玩桌上足球。 为此，我们的实现基于 Moos 等人的工作 （2024），并引入了混合自我博弈这一领域随机化（Tobin 等人，2017）的形式，通过在高度多样的策略场景中进行训练来促进早期训练。

paragraphs.en: Object-centric RL uses the fixed world frame as its dominant coordinate system. We revisit this convention and present an alternative. [words=first]Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA) expresses each object’s position and features in the frame relative to a task-relevant anchor object. ORCA does not introduce any learnable parameters, nor impose any constraints on the approaches for which this input representation can be used, except that access to the objects themselves is required. We pair ORCA with a transformer to create ORBiT.
paragraphs.zh: 以对象为中心的强化学习使用固定的世界坐标系作为其主导坐标系。 我们重新审视这一惯例，并提出一种替代方案。 [words=first]锚定对象相对坐标（ORCA）将每个对象的位置和特征表示在相对于任务相关锚定对象的坐标系中。 ORCA 不引入任何可学习参数，也不对可使用该输入表示的方法施加任何约束，唯一要求是能够访问对象本身。 我们将 ORCA 与 Transformer 结合，构建了 ORBiT。

paragraphs.en: Beyond Atari , ORBiT learns the full game of Foosball , an 8 8 -DoF continuous-control task, from scratch via self-play. Against it, PPO MLP {}^{\text{MLP}} scores only 330 330 and OCT only 73 73 of 50,000 50{,}000 goals. In Tag , where the anchor carries an orientation, ORBiT reaches 22.4 22.4 catches per episode versus 1.8 1.8 for OCT. Although trained with 5 5 distractors, it maintains this performance across different numbers of distractors from 0 0 to 10 10 . paragraphs.en: Together, these results suggest that object-centric RL should use relative rather than absolute coordinates whenever the task provides a meaningful anchor. paragraphs.en: The encoder has ℓ \ell stacked layers, each with multi-head self-attention (MHSA), a position-wise feedforward network (FFN), residual connections, and layer normalization ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . The transformer is a natural fit here: it operates on sets rather than sequences, so no positional encodings are needed, and the encoder is permutation-equivariant by construction. It also handles any N t N_{t} without modification.

paragraphs.en: The transformer encoder layers output as many tokens as objects in the input. Therefore, we need to aggregate them into a single vector before we can input them into the next neural network layers. There are several options to do this: max -aggregation, which takes the elementwise maximum of the tokens, mean -aggregation, which takes the elementwise mean of the tokens, just using the first token (see e.g., Yoon et al. (2023) ), sum -aggregation, which takes the elementwise sum of the tokens. While the last one does not scale well with the number of objects, the former ones do. In our early experiments, we found that mean -aggregation worked best, so we used it for all our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 编码器层输出的 token 数量与输入中对象的数量相同。 因此，我们需要将它们聚合为单个向量，才能将其输入到后续的神经网络层。 有几种可选的聚合方式：最大值聚合，即对 token 逐元素取最大值；均值聚合，即对 token 逐元素取平均值；直接使用第一个 token（参见例如 Yoon 等人， (2023)）；以及求和聚合，即对 token 逐元素求和。 最后一种方法在对象数量增大时扩展性不佳，而前几种方法则可以很好地扩展。 在我们的早期实验中，我们发现均值聚合效果最好，因此我们在所有实验中都采用了它。

paragraphs.en: For the Foosball task (see Figure 6 ), we build on the implementation of Moos et al. (2024) . However, we introduce some adaptations to make the environment fit for our use case. Firstly, we introduce mixed self-play (FoosballMixedSelfplay). In this training setup, the Foosball table’s rod configuration is randomized. The first Foosball table always has the full setup (i.e., the agent and the opponent control all 4 rods), but the other tables can vary. While the agent always controls at least one rod, the opponent does not; for example, the agent’s keeper rod can be the only active rod on the table. However, if there are opponent rods, the agent always controls a rod closer to its own goal than the opponent’s offense-most rod. The ball is given randomly to any of the figurines on the active rods such that both agent and opponent may be in control of the ball at the beginning of an episode. This setup provides experiences in highly varied strategic scenarios. Mixed self-play was used only for training; we always evaluated on the full game.
paragraphs.zh: 对于桌上足球任务（见图6），我们基于 Moos 等人（2024）的实现进行构建。 然而，我们引入了一些调整，使该环境适用于我们的用例。 首先，我们引入了混合自我博弈（FoosballMixedSelfplay）。 在这一训练设置中，桌上足球球的球杆配置是随机化的。 第一张桌上足球台始终采用完整配置（即智能体和对手控制全部4根球杆），但其他球台可以有所不同。 虽然智能体始终至少控制一根球杆，但对手并非如此；例如，智能体的守门员球杆可能是球台上唯一激活的球杆。 不过，如果存在对手的球杆，智能体所控制的球杆总是比对手最靠近进攻端的球杆更靠近智能体自己的球门。 球会被随机分配给激活球杆上的任意一个球员人偶，因此在回合开始时，智能体和对手都可能是球的控制方。 这种设置提供了在高度多样化策略场景中的经验。 混合自我博弈仅用于训练；我们始终在完整对局中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Tag is an object-centric 2D environment in a bounded square arena of side length 10 10 . Each episode contains the player, the target, five distractors, and two static landmark objects. The agent’s task is to catch the moving target object. A catch is registered when the player comes within 1 unit of the target. On each catch, the agent receives a reward of + 1 +1 , and the target, as well as the five distractors, are randomly redistributed in the environment more than 3 units away from the player, each with a random heading and a speed drawn uniformly from [ 0 , 0.5 ] [0,0.5] . The landmarks are positioned at ( 2.5 , 2.5 ) (2.5,2.5) and ( 7.5 , 7.5 ) (7.5,7.5) with opposing heading angles. The episode ends either on catch or after 500 environment steps during training; during evaluation, it ends after 500 environment steps, and we report the number of catches made within this time frame.
paragraphs.zh: Tag 是一个以物体为中心的二维环境，位于边长为 10 10 的有界正方形竞技场中。 每个回合包含玩家、目标、五个干扰物和两个静态地标物体。 智能体的任务是捕捉移动的目标物体。 当玩家进入目标 1 个单位范围内时，记为一次捕捉。 每次捕捉时，智能体获得 + 1 +1 的奖励，并且目标以及五个干扰物会被随机重新分布到环境中距玩家 3 个单位以外的位置，各自具有随机的朝向和从 [ 0 , 0.5 ] [0,0.5] 中均匀抽取的速度。 地标分别位于 ( 2.5 , 2.5 ) (2.5,2.5) 和 ( 7.5 , 7.5 ) (7.5,7.5)，朝向角度相反。 回合在捕捉成功或训练中经过 500 个环境步后结束；在评估时，回合在 500 个环境步后结束，我们报告在此时间范围内的捕捉次数。
